title: [2.7.1-dev] [cosmetic-issue] AAPS show carbs in change request in extrem precision
body:
![20210101_230019](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8592414/103447220-6c3afb00-4c88-11eb-8515-1a032492deea.jpg)

AAPS show carbs in change request in extrem precision.

comments.body: This is not a real issue, rather inconsistency in rounding nubmbers...
It is an cosmetic issue, not a really bug.
This cosmetic issue disappears once you close the loop.

It is possible, but not all users use every time closed loop. Maybe the pump is not supported, the objectives are not complete or other reasons... Nobody say, that cosmetic issues have a high priority.
